Content: MemorySmith chat is provider-based with two implementations. OllamaChatProvider uses /api/chat with stream=true for NDJSON streaming, /api/tags for model discovery, and now sends num_ctx for context window governance. It handles malformed NDJSON lines gracefully (try/catch per line). GitHubCopilotChatProvider uses GitHub.Copilot.SDK with token auth resolved from configurable env vars (GH_TOKEN, COPILOT_API_KEY fallback chain). MemoryChatAgent orchestrates: context preloading via ChatContextPlanner, tool call interception via ChatIntentInterceptor, a shared ChatToolCatalog (22+ tools), streaming with render throttle (4-8 Hz StateHasChanged), and an agent-write proposal workflow with approval modes. Provider-native tool calling is available as a capability upgrade path. The chat agent writes transcripts for the training harness when ChatTranscriptEnabled is true. Chat sessions persist to browser localStorage with configurable retention.
Title: Chat Agent Provider Architecture
